name: Paddle Billing
description: Paddle Billing, the merchant of record for software sales: products, prices and discounts, customers with addresses and businesses, subscriptions (update, pause, resume, cancel, previews), transactions and PDF invoices, refunds and credits, reports, revenue and MRR metrics, events and webhook notifications. Live or sandbox.
instructions:
## Paddle Billing
This connector uses the **Paddle Billing API** (`https://api.paddle.com`, sandbox `https://sandbox-api.paddle.com`). Paddle is a merchant of record for software and digital products: it sells to the customer, handles tax and pays you out. The connector reads and manages the catalog (products, prices, discounts), customers with their addresses and businesses, subscriptions, transactions and invoices, refunds and credits, reports, dashboard metrics, events and webhook notifications. It covers Paddle Billing only, not Paddle Classic.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. In Paddle open **Developer tools**, **Authentication**, **API keys** and create a key. Give it the permissions the tools need: read for products, prices, discounts, customers, addresses, businesses, subscriptions, transactions, adjustments, reports, notifications and events; write for the ones you want the AI to change.
2. Paste the key into `PADDLE_API_KEY`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
3. Set `PADDLE_API_URL` to `https://api.paddle.com` for the live account or `https://sandbox-api.paddle.com` for a sandbox account. Sandbox and live keys only work on their own host.
4. Run `paddle_list_event_types` to check the key.

**Workflow**
- Catalog: `paddle_list_products` (include prices), `paddle_get_product`, `paddle_create_product`, `paddle_update_product`; prices with `paddle_list_prices`, `paddle_get_price`, `paddle_create_price`, `paddle_update_price`; discounts with `paddle_list_discounts`, `paddle_get_discount`, `paddle_create_discount`, `paddle_update_discount`. Nothing is deleted in Paddle: set `status` to archived instead.
- Customers: `paddle_list_customers` (search by email), `paddle_get_customer`, `paddle_create_customer`, `paddle_update_customer`. Addresses: `paddle_list_customer_addresses`, `paddle_create_customer_address`, `paddle_update_customer_address`. Businesses (VAT number, company): `paddle_list_customer_businesses`, `paddle_create_customer_business`, `paddle_update_customer_business`. `paddle_list_customer_credit_balances` shows credit, `paddle_create_customer_portal_session` gives the customer a link to manage payment methods and subscriptions.
- Subscriptions: `paddle_list_subscriptions`, `paddle_get_subscription` (include next_transaction for the next charge). To change plan or quantity, run `paddle_preview_subscription_update` first and show the user the immediate charge, then `paddle_update_subscription` with the full new `items` list and a `proration_billing_mode`. Lifecycle: `paddle_pause_subscription`, `paddle_resume_subscription`, `paddle_cancel_subscription`, `paddle_activate_subscription` (ends a trial and bills now). A scheduled pause or cancel is removed with `paddle_update_subscription` and `scheduled_change: null`. `paddle_create_subscription_charge` bills a one-time charge on the saved payment method and `paddle_cancel_subscription` ends a subscription; both are installed switched off.
- Transactions and invoices: `paddle_list_transactions` (by customer, subscription, status, invoice number, billed or created date range), `paddle_get_transaction`, `paddle_get_transaction_invoice` for the PDF link. `paddle_create_transaction` creates a checkout to pay (its `checkout.url`) or, with `collection_mode: manual` and `status: billed`, an invoice; `paddle_update_transaction` changes a draft or ready one. Quotes without saving: `paddle_preview_transaction`, `paddle_preview_prices`.
- Refunds and credits: `paddle_list_adjustments`, `paddle_create_adjustment` (refunds are reviewed by Paddle and start as pending_approval), `paddle_get_adjustment_credit_note`.
- Reports and numbers: `paddle_create_report`, then `paddle_get_report` until status is ready, then `paddle_get_report_csv`; `paddle_list_reports` lists earlier ones. Dashboard metrics per day: `paddle_get_revenue_metrics`, `paddle_get_mrr_metrics`, `paddle_get_active_subscribers_metrics`.
- Events and webhooks: `paddle_list_event_types`, `paddle_list_events` (last 90 days), `paddle_list_notification_settings`, `paddle_list_notifications`, `paddle_get_notification`, `paddle_list_notification_logs`, `paddle_replay_notification`.

**Before writing**: transactions billed, subscription updates, cancellations, refunds and one-time charges affect real money on the live host. Show the user what will change (use the preview tools) and wait for a yes.

**Reading the answers**: every response has `data` and `meta.request_id`. Ids carry a prefix: `pro_` product, `pri_` price, `dsc_` discount, `ctm_` customer, `add_` address, `biz_` business, `sub_` subscription, `txn_` transaction, `adj_` adjustment, `rep_` report, `ntf_` notification. Amounts are strings in the lowest currency unit (`"1999"` USD = 19.99; JPY has no decimals). Totals of a transaction are in `details.totals` (subtotal, discount, tax, total, grand_total) and per item in `details.line_items`. Dates are RFC 3339 in UTC. Filters that take several values are comma-separated.

**Paging**: list tools return up to `per_page` items (50 by default, 200 at most). When `meta.pagination.has_more` is true, take the `after` value from the `meta.pagination.next` URL and pass it as `after`.

**Limits and errors**: 240 requests per minute per IP (429 above that). Errors come as `error.type`, `error.code` and `error.detail`, with `error.errors` listing invalid fields. 403 `forbidden` means the API key lacks the permission for that entity; 401 means a wrong key or a sandbox key on the live host (or the reverse); 404 `entity_not_found` a wrong id or the other environment.
prerequisites: A Paddle Billing account (live or sandbox) and an API key from Developer tools, Authentication, with the permissions the tools need.

PADDLE_API_KEY.label: API key
PADDLE_API_KEY.help: Paddle, Developer tools, Authentication, API keys: create a key with the permissions you need. Live keys start with pdl_live_apikey_, sandbox keys with pdl_sdbx_apikey_.
PADDLE_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without spaces, quotes or a Bearer prefix.

PADDLE_API_URL.label: API environment
PADDLE_API_URL.help: https://api.paddle.com for the live account, https://sandbox-api.paddle.com for a sandbox account. The key must belong to the same environment.
PADDLE_API_URL.patternMessage: Use https://api.paddle.com or https://sandbox-api.paddle.com, without a trailing slash.

verifyHints.401: Paddle refused the API key. Check that it was copied whole and that it belongs to the environment in PADDLE_API_URL (sandbox keys only work on sandbox-api.paddle.com).
verifyHints.403: The key works but lacks the permission for this entity. Edit the API key in Paddle, Developer tools, Authentication, and add the read or write permission.
verifyHints.429: Paddle allows 240 requests per minute per IP address. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: paddle_list_products
tools.description: List products in the catalog with name, tax category, type, status and custom data. Include prices to get each product's prices in the same call. Paged with after and per_page.

type.description: standard (catalog) or custom (one-off, created for a single transaction).

tax_category.description: Only these tax categories, e.g. standard,saas, comma-separated.

include.description: prices: also return the product's prices.

order_by.description: Sort, e.g. id[ASC] or id[DESC] (default id[ASC]). Sortable: created_at, custom_data, id, description, image_url, name, status, tax_category, updated_at.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: the id after which to continue, taken from meta.pagination.next (the after= value).

tools.name: paddle_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id (pro_...) with its name, description, tax category, image URL, status and custom data; include prices to list its prices too.

include.description: prices: also return the product's prices.

tools.name: paddle_create_product
tools.description: Create a catalog product (what you sell). Add one or more prices to it with paddle_create_price before it can be bought. Returns the new product with its pro_ id.

tax_category.description: Tax category: standard for most items, saas for software as a service, digital-goods, ebooks, implementation-services, professional-services, software-programming-services, training-services, website-hosting. Categories other than standard and saas need Paddle approval.

description.description: Short description shown at checkout and on invoices.

type.description: standard (default, part of the catalog) or custom.

image_url.description: HTTPS URL of a square product image.

custom_data.description: Your own key-value data stored on the entity, e.g. {"crm_id": "123"}.

tools.name: paddle_update_product
tools.description: Update a product: name, description, tax category, image, custom data, or archive it with status archived. Only the fields passed change.

tax_category.description: Tax category: standard for most items, saas for software as a service, digital-goods, ebooks, implementation-services, professional-services, software-programming-services, training-services, website-hosting. Categories other than standard and saas need Paddle approval.

image_url.description: HTTPS URL of a square product image.

custom_data.description: Your own key-value data stored on the entity, e.g. {"crm_id": "123"}.

status.description: Filter by status: active or archived.

tools.name: paddle_list_prices
tools.description: List prices with their product id, unit price (amount in the lowest currency unit), billing cycle, trial period, quantity limits and status. Filter by product or by recurring/one-time.

recurring.description: true: only prices with a billing cycle (subscriptions); false: only one-time prices.

include.description: product: also return the related product.

order_by.description: Sort, e.g. id[ASC] or id[DESC] (default id[ASC]). Sortable: billing_cycle.frequency, billing_cycle.interval, id, product_id, quantity.maximum, quantity.minimum, status, tax_mode, unit_price.amount, unit_price.currency_code.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: the id after which to continue, taken from meta.pagination.next (the after= value).

tools.name: paddle_get_price
tools.description: Get one price by id (pri_...): product, description, unit price and overrides per country, billing cycle, trial period, tax mode and quantity limits.

include.description: product: also return the related product.

tools.name: paddle_create_price
tools.description: Create a price for a product: amount and currency, optional billing cycle (subscription) and trial, country overrides and quantity limits. Returns the new pri_ id used in checkouts and transactions.

product_id.description: Product id (pro_...) the price belongs to.

description.description: Internal description, e.g. Monthly (per seat). Not shown to customers.

unit_price.description: Unit price: {"amount": "1000", "currency_code": "USD"}. amount is a string in the lowest currency unit (1000 = 10.00 USD).

name.description: Name shown to customers at checkout and on invoices.

billing_cycle.description: Billing cycle for recurring prices: {"interval": "month", "frequency": 1}; interval is day, week, month or year. Leave out for a one-time price.

trial_period.description: Trial period: {"interval": "day", "frequency": 14}. Requires a billing cycle.

tax_mode.description: account_setting (default), external (prices exclude tax) or internal (prices include tax).

custom_data.description: Your own key-value data stored on the entity, e.g. {"crm_id": "123"}.

tools.name: paddle_update_price
tools.description: Update a price: description, name, amount, billing cycle, trial, overrides, quantity limits, custom data, or archive it. Existing subscriptions keep their price until they are updated.

unit_price.description: Unit price: {"amount": "1000", "currency_code": "USD"}. amount is a string in the lowest currency unit (1000 = 10.00 USD).

billing_cycle.description: Billing cycle for recurring prices: {"interval": "month", "frequency": 1}; interval is day, week, month or year. Leave out for a one-time price.

trial_period.description: Trial period: {"interval": "day", "frequency": 14}. Requires a billing cycle.

tools.description: List discounts with code, type (flat, flat_per_seat, percentage), amount, recurring settings, usage limit, times used, expiry and status. Filter by code or status.

discount_group_id.description: Only these discount group ids (dsg_...), comma-separated.

tools.description: Get one discount by id (dsc_...): code, type, amount, currency, whether it recurs and for how many intervals, usage limit, times used, restrictions and expiry.

tools.description: Create a discount: percentage or flat amount, optional checkout code, recurring behaviour, usage limit, product or price restrictions and expiry. Returns the new dsc_ id.

description.description: Internal description, not shown to customers.

type.description: flat (fixed amount off the total), flat_per_seat (fixed amount per unit) or percentage.

currency_code.description: Currency for flat and flat_per_seat discounts, e.g. USD or EUR.

recur.description: Whether the discount applies to recurring renewals as well as the first payment.

maximum_recurring_intervals.description: With recur: on how many renewals it applies; leave out for forever.

usage_limit.description: How many times the discount can be redeemed in total.

restrict_to.description: Only these product or price ids (pro_..., pri_...).

custom_data.description: Your own key-value data stored on the entity, e.g. {"crm_id": "123"}.

tools.description: Create authenticated links to the Paddle customer portal for a customer, where they can update payment methods, see invoices and cancel. Optionally deep links for given subscriptions.

tools.name: paddle_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions with status, customer, address, items (price and quantity), currency, billing period, next billing date and any scheduled change (pause, cancel, resume).

status.description: Comma-separated statuses: active, canceled, past_due, paused, trialing.

scheduled_change_action.description: Comma-separated scheduled change actions: cancel, pause, resume.

order_by.description: Sort, e.g. id[ASC] or id[DESC] (default id[ASC]). Sortable: id.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: the id after which to continue, taken from meta.pagination.next (the after= value).

tools.name: paddle_get_subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription by id (sub_...): status, customer, items, discount, billing cycle and current period, next billing date, scheduled change and management URLs. include next_transaction previews the next charge.

include.description: Comma-separated: next_transaction (preview of the next renewal) and/or recurring_transaction_details.

tools.name: paddle_preview_subscription_update
tools.description: Preview what an update to a subscription would charge or credit, without changing it: immediate transaction, next transaction and the resulting subscription. Same fields as paddle_update_subscription.

items.description: The complete new list of items: [{"price_id": "pri_...", "quantity": 1}]. Items left out are removed.

proration_billing_mode.description: How to bill the change: prorated_immediately, prorated_next_billing_period, full_immediately, full_next_billing_period or do_not_bill. Required when items change.

customer_id.description: Move the subscription to this customer (ctm_...).

business_id.description: New business id (biz_...); null removes it.

currency_code.description: New currency, e.g. EUR (manual collection allows USD, EUR, GBP).

discount.description: Apply a discount: {"id": "dsc_...", "effective_from": "next_billing_period"}; null removes the discount.

scheduled_change.description: Pass null to remove a scheduled pause, resume or cancellation; no other value is accepted.

on_payment_failure.description: prevent_change (default) or apply_change when the immediate charge fails.

custom_data.description: Your own key-value data stored on the entity, e.g. {"crm_id": "123"}.

tools.name: paddle_update_subscription
tools.description: Update a subscription: change items or quantities (upgrade, downgrade, add-ons) with a proration mode, apply a discount, change billing date, address, collection mode or remove a scheduled change. May charge the customer at once.

items.description: The complete new list of items: [{"price_id": "pri_...", "quantity": 1}]. Items left out are removed.

proration_billing_mode.description: How to bill the change: prorated_immediately, prorated_next_billing_period, full_immediately, full_next_billing_period or do_not_bill. Required when items change.

customer_id.description: Move the subscription to this customer (ctm_...).

business_id.description: New business id (biz_...); null removes it.

currency_code.description: New currency, e.g. EUR (manual collection allows USD, EUR, GBP).

discount.description: Apply a discount: {"id": "dsc_...", "effective_from": "next_billing_period"}; null removes the discount.

scheduled_change.description: Pass null to remove a scheduled pause, resume or cancellation; no other value is accepted.

on_payment_failure.description: prevent_change (default) or apply_change when the immediate charge fails.

custom_data.description: Your own key-value data stored on the entity, e.g. {"crm_id": "123"}.

tools.name: paddle_pause_subscription
tools.description: Pause a subscription at the end of the billing period (default) or immediately, optionally with a date to resume automatically. While paused nothing is billed.

effective_from.description: next_billing_period (default, at the end of the paid period) or immediately.

resume_at.description: Resume automatically at this RFC 3339 date-time; leave out to pause until resumed.

on_resume.description: continue_existing_billing_period (default) or start_new_billing_period when it resumes.

tools.name: paddle_resume_subscription
tools.description: Resume a paused subscription now (effective_from immediately) or at a given date-time, or change the date of a scheduled resume. Resuming may start billing at once.

effective_from.description: immediately, or an RFC 3339 date-time in the future.

tools.name: paddle_cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel a subscription at the end of the billing period (default, can be undone by removing the scheduled change) or immediately (final). Show the user the subscription first and wait for a yes.

effective_from.description: next_billing_period (default, at the end of the paid period) or immediately.

tools.name: paddle_activate_subscription
tools.description: End the trial of a trialing subscription now and start billing it: the first payment is collected immediately. Only for trialing subscriptions with automatic collection.

items.description: Items to charge: [{"price_id": "pri_...", "quantity": 1}] (one-time prices or inline price objects).

checkout.description: {"url": "https://example.com/pay"}: your approved checkout page for the payment link.

custom_data.description: Your own key-value data stored on the entity, e.g. {"crm_id": "123"}.

include.description: Comma-separated related entities to include: address, adjustments, adjustments_totals, available_payment_methods, business, customer, discount.

tools.name: paddle_preview_transaction
tools.description: Preview a transaction without creating it: line items, tax, discounts and totals for given prices, customer or location. Nothing is saved; use it to quote a price.

address_id.description: Address id (add_...) for the tax location.

address.description: Tax location without a saved address: {"country_code": "DE", "postal_code": "10115"}.

customer_ip_address.description: Customer IP address, used to estimate the tax location.

ignore_trials.description: true: calculate as if trial periods did not apply.

tools.name: paddle_get_transaction_invoice
tools.description: Get a temporary link to the PDF invoice of a billed or completed transaction. The returned data.url expires after about an hour; share it right away.

disposition.description: attachment (download, default) or inline (open in the browser).

tools.name: paddle_preview_prices
tools.description: Localized price preview for a list of prices: subtotal, tax, discount and total per item in the customer's currency and country, as on a pricing page. Nothing is saved.

address_id.description: Address id (add_...) for the tax location.

address.description: Tax location without a saved address: {"country_code": "DE", "postal_code": "10115"}.

customer_ip_address.description: Customer IP address, used to estimate the tax location.

tools.name: paddle_list_adjustments
tools.description: List adjustments (refunds, credits, chargebacks) with action, status (pending_approval, approved, rejected, reversed), transaction, subscription, customer, reason and totals.

action.description: Comma-separated actions: credit, refund, chargeback, chargeback_reverse, chargeback_warning, chargeback_warning_reverse, credit_reverse.

status.description: Comma-separated statuses: pending_approval, approved, rejected, reversed.

order_by.description: Sort, e.g. id[ASC] or id[DESC] (default id[ASC]). Sortable: id.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: the id after which to continue, taken from meta.pagination.next (the after= value).

tools.name: paddle_create_adjustment
tools.description: Refund or credit a billed or completed transaction, fully or for some items. Refunds go to Paddle for approval (status pending_approval) and return money to the customer; confirm with the user first.

action.description: refund (money back to the customer) or credit (credit balance for manually collected transactions).

reason.description: Why, e.g. Customer requested refund. Shown in Paddle.

type.description: full (the whole transaction, default when items are left out) or partial.

items.description: For partial: [{"item_id": "txnitm_...", "type": "partial", "amount": "500"}] or type full per item. item_id from the transaction details.line_items[].id.

tax_mode.description: internal (default, amounts include tax) or external.

tools.name: paddle_get_adjustment_credit_note
tools.description: Get a temporary link to the PDF credit note of an approved adjustment. The returned data.url expires after about an hour.

tools.name: paddle_list_reports
tools.description: List reports you requested with type, status (pending, ready, failed, expired), filters, row count and expiry. Ready reports can be downloaded with paddle_get_report_csv.

status.description: Comma-separated statuses: pending, ready, failed, expired.

order_by.description: Sort, e.g. id[ASC] or id[DESC] (default id[ASC]). Sortable: id.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: the id after which to continue, taken from meta.pagination.next (the after= value).

tools.name: paddle_create_report
tools.description: Request a CSV report: transactions, transaction_line_items, adjustments, adjustment_line_items, discounts, products_prices, balance, payout_reconciliation, checkouts or subscriptions, with filters such as a date range.

filters.description: Filters: [{"name": "updated_at", "operator": "gte", "value": "2026-10-01"}, {"name": "updated_at", "operator": "lt", "value": "2026-11-01"}, {"name": "status", "operator": null, "value": ["completed"]}]. Names depend on the type (status, collection_mode, currency_code, origin, action, type, updated_at, ...).

tools.name: paddle_get_report
tools.description: Get one report by id (rep_...): type, status, filters, number of rows and when it expires. Poll it until status is ready, then call paddle_get_report_csv.

tools.name: paddle_get_report_csv
tools.description: Get a temporary download link for a ready report as CSV. The returned data.url expires after a few minutes.

tools.name: paddle_get_revenue_metrics
tools.description: Net revenue per day for a date range in the account balance currency, as shown in the Paddle dashboard (amounts in the lowest currency unit).

to.description: Day after the last day, YYYY-MM-DD; must be on or after from.

tools.name: paddle_get_mrr_metrics
tools.description: Monthly recurring revenue per day for a date range, as shown in the Paddle dashboard (amounts in the lowest currency unit).

to.description: Day after the last day, YYYY-MM-DD; must be on or after from.

tools.name: paddle_get_active_subscribers_metrics
tools.description: Number of active subscribers per day for a date range, as shown in the Paddle dashboard metrics.

to.description: Day after the last day, YYYY-MM-DD; must be on or after from.

tools.name: paddle_list_event_types
tools.description: List the event types Paddle can send (transaction.completed, subscription.canceled, ...) with a description and the API version of each. Needs no ids; useful to check the key.

tools.name: paddle_list_events
tools.description: List events (what happened in the account): event_type, occurred_at and the full entity in data. Kept for 90 days. Filter by type or time range.

from.description: Occurred at or after this RFC 3339 date-time.

order_by.description: Sort, e.g. id[ASC] or id[DESC] (default id[ASC]). Sortable: id.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: the id after which to continue, taken from meta.pagination.next (the after= value).

tools.name: paddle_list_notification_settings
tools.description: List notification destinations (webhook URLs and emails) with their subscribed event types, active flag and API version. Ids start with ntfset_.

tools.name: paddle_list_notifications
tools.description: List webhook and email notifications sent for events, with status (delivered, failed, needs_retry, not_attempted), times attempted and the destination. Filter by status, destination or time.

status.description: Comma-separated statuses: delivered, failed, needs_retry, not_attempted.

notification_setting_id.description: Only these notification setting ids (ntfset_...), comma-separated.

search.description: Search by event, notification or entity id.

filter.description: Only notifications for this entity id or event type.

from.description: Created at or after this RFC 3339 date-time.

order_by.description: Sort, e.g. id[ASC] or id[DESC] (default id[ASC]). Sortable: id.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: the id after which to continue, taken from meta.pagination.next (the after= value).

tools.name: paddle_get_notification
tools.description: Get one notification by id (ntf_...): status, event payload, destination, attempts and last error. Use paddle_list_notification_logs for each delivery attempt.

tools.name: paddle_list_notification_logs
tools.description: List the delivery attempts of a notification with the HTTP status and response body your endpoint returned, to debug failing webhooks.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: the id after which to continue, taken from meta.pagination.next (the after= value).

tools.name: paddle_replay_notification
tools.description: Send a notification again to its destination, e.g. after fixing a failing webhook endpoint. Creates a new notification with origin replay.
